title: Summit Miles Upgrade Charge: Miles and Co-Pay
content:
The charge for a cleared Crestline Summit Loyalty Program miles upgrade is computed as follows.

**Upgrade charged.** The upgrade charged is the latest miles upgrade clearance on the membership, on the ticket and segment that clearance names.

**Miles.** Its miles are the base miles upgrade cost for that segment's length, as the upgrades policy sets them: the tier's miles per segment for segments up to the ticket's segment length threshold, and the tier's miles per longer segment above it.

**Shared co-pay.** The shared co-pay of the segment is the miles upgrade co-pay per segment of the tier the member holds, multiplied by its co-pay share percent. The co-pay share percent is 100 percent.

**Co-pay to charge.** The co-pay to charge is the shared co-pay. The co-pay charged for the segment is the co-pay to charge, in dollars and cents.

| Item | Taken from |
|---|---|
| Ticket and segment | The latest miles upgrade clearance |
| Miles | The tier's miles upgrade cost for the segment's length |
| Shared co-pay | The tier's miles upgrade co-pay per segment times the co-pay share percent of 100 percent |
| Co-pay charged | The co-pay to charge |

**Hypothetical illustration.** For a member whose tier sets a co-pay of 75 USD per segment and a short-segment cost of 15000 miles, a cleared segment up to the threshold has a shared co-pay of 75.00 USD and is charged 15000 miles and 75.00 USD.
